description: Single precision op-amp with 3 fA typical input bias current (±20 fA max at 25°C), ±26 µV offset voltage, 17 MHz GBW and 1.3 mA supply current, running from 1.8 V to 5.5 V. Its non-standard SOIC-8 pinout keeps the inputs away from the supply and output pins. Uses include electrometers, photodiode amplifiers and transimpedance amplifiers.

groups.description: Positive supply V+ on pin 6. The device runs from a total supply of 1.8 V to 5.5 V, with a 6.0 V absolute maximum, and draws about 1.3 mA.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: Negative supply V- on pin 3. Connect it to ground in single-supply designs or to the negative rail in split-supply designs.
groups.name: GROUND

groups.description: Analog op-amp signal pins: non-inverting input IN+ (pin 1), inverting input IN- (pin 8) and output VOUT (pin 4). The two inputs are placed on opposite corners, away from the supply and output pins, to reduce leakage into the femtoamp-level inputs.
groups.name: OTHER

groups.description: Pins 2, 5 and 7 have no internal connection. The datasheet recommends connecting pins 2 and 7 to a guard trace driven at the input common-mode potential. Pin 5 can be left floating.
groups.name: NC

pins.description: Non-inverting input. Input bias current is 3 fA typical, ±20 fA max at 25°C (VCM = 1 V). Input voltage must stay between V- - 0.3 V and V+ + 0.3 V, and the differential input is limited to ±0.3 V.
pins.name: IN+

pins.description: No internal connection. The datasheet recommends connecting it to the system guard trace that surrounds the input pins.
pins.name: N/C

pins.description: Negative power supply (or ground in single-supply use). Total supply VS = V+ - V- is 1.8 V to 5.5 V (2.0 V min below 0°C), with an absolute maximum of 6.0 V.
pins.name: V-

pins.description: Positive power supply. VS = V+ - V- is 1.8 V to 5.5 V; supply current is about 1.3 mA. Decouple close to the pin.
pins.name: V+

pins.description: No internal connection. The datasheet recommends connecting it to the system guard trace that surrounds the input pins.
pins.name: N/C

pins.description: Inverting input. It has the same ultra-low bias current as IN+ (3 fA typical). It sits on the opposite side of the package from IN+, with guard pins next to it to cut PCB leakage.
pins.name: IN-

variants.notes: This is the only package listed (D package, θJA = 190 °C/W). The 'MAX' tape-and-reel suffix comes from TI's usual naming and was not checked against the orderable addendum.
